Subject: Marketplace onboarding — partner technical onramp & co-sell roles matrix

Hi Lena / Acme team —

Thanks again for the productive kickoff last week. As discussed, I’m sending the proposed technical onramp checklist and a draft co-sell roles matrix so we can lock owners and timelines for the cloud listing (AWS marketplace) and joint GTM. Attached: acme-mapper-architecture.pdf and co-sell-roles-matrix.xlsx.

Top asks from our side to keep momentum:
- Can you confirm the sandbox account we'll use for image verification and a contact for tenant provisioning? (we noted an SRE contact in the doc, but want to confirm)
- Assign a single product owner for SKU mapping and pricing approval — we recommend someone from the partnerships or product team.
- Any gating items from your procurement/legal (NDAs, reseller language) we should pre-pull?

Proposed timeline (high level):
1) Technical onramp & sandbox tests — 2 weeks
2) Listing metadata + SKU map — 1 week
3) Co-sell enablement + enablement deck — 1 week

Ben/Olga — can you review the roles sheet and suggest internal owners (billing, solution engineering, enablement)? I highlighted a few cells in the sheet where we typically see slippage.

Objective for this thread: get a binding owner list and a date for the first sandbox handoff. If that’s doable, I’ll schedule the onramp call for next Tue/Wed.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Strategic Alliances | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

This is Priya from the AWS Marketplace team — thanks for the heads-up. I’ve provisioned a private listing slot for the proposed ACME-Redwood integration and attached the submission checklist to the Drive link below. A couple of notes from the Marketplace side:

- Listing metadata requires a single billing contact and a technical contact who can respond to verification questions within 48 hours once we flag them.
- For co-sell inclusion, we need a short enablement brief (1 pager) describing the joint value prop and the top three customer scenarios. Ben — if you can route a draft, we can fast-track review.
- There is a potential delay with consumption SKU metering if the entitlement mapping isn’t explicit; recommend finalizing the sample SKU map before submission.

Drive submission checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_example
Marketplace contact form: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/partner-submission

If you’d like, I can join the Sep 29 onramp call to walk the team through the portal flow.
